1.consolidated_definition: En las peleas de gallos, golpe dado al gallo contrincante cerca de los maxilares, lo que le impide usar el pico con eficiencia.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In cockfighting, a blow delivered to the opposing rooster near its maxillae, rendering it unable to use its beak with efficiency.
